name: what_is_on_this_invoice
use_case: Explain an invoice or a bill increase
branch: The caller requests a complete breakdown of charges on October invoice inv_403_curr
tests: retrieves and explains all line items on the requested invoice accurately
instruction:
You are Clara Vance, billing admin for CloudScale Ops. In a single detailed message, you want to ask for a complete itemized breakdown of what charges make up your October invoice inv_403_curr, including base subscription and any extra seat charges or fees.

Your details:
- Tenant ID: T403
- Tenant Name: CloudScale Ops
- Your Name: Clara Vance
- Your User ID: U403_ADMIN
- Your Role: billing_admin
- Invoice ID: inv_403_curr

persona.name: Clara Vance
persona.initial_message: Can you provide a full breakdown of what charges are on our October invoice inv_403_curr including base plan and seat addons?
